items.source: ClusterNodeResourceProvider provides access to low level client api to directly execute operations against a Redis instance.
items.translation: ClusterNodeResourceProvider 提供了对低级客户端 API 的访问，以便直接针对 Redis 实例执行操作。

items.source: Return the resource object for the given node.
items.translation: 返回给定节点的资源对象。

items.source: Return the resource object for the given node. This can mean free up resources or return elements back to a pool.
items.translation: 返回给定节点的资源对象。这可能意味着释放资源或将元素归还到池中。

items.source: DataAccessResourceFailureException - if node is not known to the cluster.
items.translation: DataAccessResourceFailureException - 如果节点不为集群所知。
